caveat: An identification count, not an abundance, and the deposit's own search output rather than a published table: the article's supplement reports per-organism totals and a glycolytic-enzyme table, never a per-protein value for this organism. Counts are rank-1 MS-GF+ matches at q <= 0.01 whose peptide is unique to one protein; a spectrum whose peptide is shared between proteins is counted for neither, and decoys are dropped. Spectral counting measures abundance only coarsely and favours long and readily ionised proteins. A protein has a value only where all three replicates identified it. The survey grew every organism once to early stationary phase at its own listed conditions, and 22 °C unshaken is well below this organism's usual cultivation, so these layers are not comparable to the 30 °C datasets without care. Measured in PCC 7942, not UTEX 2973, and keyed by UniProt accession through UniProt's ordered-locus names and the one-to-one crosswalk.
